outcome: haemodynamic disorders in the mother-placenta-fetus system
cohort: 100 pregnant women with gestational diabetes mellitus
finding: Early treatment of gestational diabetes mellitus and patient motivation to follow lifestyle and nutrition recommendations significantly improved pregnancy outcomes and reduced the likelihood of complications.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was performed in 66% of the women.
birth_weight: 10% of newborns had a birth weight >=4000 g, whereas 25% of newborns were large for gestational age
